title: Exactness inherited by the rational projective-line restrictions
statement: For triangulated object properties P and Q and an exact commutative-shift functor F preserving P into Q, the induced lift of F between the full subcategories P and Q admits a commutative-shift structure and is triangulated.

source.place: Exactness: restriction of the ambient functors

proof.text: Use the inherited shift structure on the full-subcategory lift and the `ObjectProperty.isTriangulated_lift` construction. The resulting commutative-shift instance and triangulated-functor instance give the existential witness.

source.place: Exactness: restriction of the ambient functors

proof_origin.place: Exactness: restriction of the ambient functors

lean.statement:
theorem rationalP1_restrictedFunctorExactness
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasZeroObject D] [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D]
    [HasShift C ℤ] [HasShift D ℤ]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated C] [Pretriangulated D]
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (Q : ObjectProperty D)
    [P.IsTriangulated] [Q.IsTriangulated]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (hF : ∀ A : P.FullSubcategory, Q (F.obj A.obj)) :
    ∃ s : (Q.lift (P.ι ⋙ F) (fun A ↦ hF A)).CommShift ℤ,
      letI := s
      (Q.lift (P.ι ⋙ F) (fun A ↦ hF A)).IsTriangulated
